title: Excellent experience.
text: A very pleasant evening with a wonderful flamenco show.
author: Krieger72

title: Unforgettable experience, we all loved it!
text: Magnificent show, I was deeply moved by the performances of the dancers, the singers, and the musician. They transported me far, very far from the theater! What virtuosity and what energy! Bravo to the Artists!
author: lilianedourou

title: Excellent performance by...
text: Excellent authentic performance by the musician, singers, and dancers. Very nice venue in a quiet area away from the center. Would highly recommend.
author: Sara_A

title: Excellent show
text: Excellent show, very enjoyable. Small but modern theater with good staff and drinks. Nice to see some traditional dancing and it was quiet, so very enjoyable.
author: Faith_N

title: Great experience
text: I booked this last minute on Viator and I am so glad I did! The performance was incredible (the guitarist brought a tear to my eye) and the service was quick, friendly and attentive. So pleased I did it.
author: Alison_A

title: Phenomenal
text: This performance was truly remarkable and beautiful, with performers who were all outstanding. It ranks among the most beautiful experiences during our trip to Spain.
author: Domingo_R

title: An experience to repeat.
text: Spectacular site and lots of art... it felt a bit short to us... TO BE REPEATED.
author: MIGUEL73
